task_definition.task_description:
Please check whether my investment account is active, then look up the current price of BTC and AAPL and identify the direct quote profile for AAPL. After that, reserve 1 Apple AirPods for me and generate a PayPal invoice for $249 sent to alice@company.com, then get the information for Hilton Tokyo.

Also, scan the living room for smart devices, get the discovered smart lock ticket there, archive that lock as “Living room lock archive” for user_01 with medium priority through the app, then format the archive details and send them in an instant message to u_alice.

user_input.query:
Please check whether my investment account is active, then look up the current price of BTC in EUR and AAPL, and identify the direct quote profile for AAPL. After that, reserve 1 Apple AirPods for me using product_id p_apple_airpods, and generate a PayPal invoice for $249 sent to alice@company.com. Then get the information for Hilton Tokyo.

Also, please scan the living_room for smart devices in the living room, find the discovered smart lock ticket there, archive that lock as “Living room lock archive” for user_01 with medium priority through the app, and then format the archive details and send them in an instant message to u_alice. For the item details, use items [{ product_id: p_apple_airpods, quantity: 1 }], and quantity 1 as specified.
